experiments.scope: The blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target. Each trial executes the search of proof.md 9.1, 9.8 and 9.9 on the priced instance (flags 3, counter t by step CT) for one context: seven outer words and eight members from the seed, the test of W, the 39 context lines; per member its walk over the first 2^10 steps s, t_hi = s XOR (ROL(K1.d1,16) mod 2^16), in blocks of constant X0 >> 16 with the level-16 test of automaton (2); per live block its pieces, ranges and list words with the packed Y9 fill, the T1 replicas and the word test; per passing lane the shortcut, the pre-check of 9.7, the preflight, the joint screen of 9.9 on every row of T, and the joint solver of 9.4 with (G7) and (G15) on the rows that pass the screen, with the root predicate; for a certified root, both last-chunk compressions at counter t and the 256-bit test. In-run checks: omega of blocks against step CO, every 8th E lane against step CO, bit-serial masks and a real compression, every passing lane against a scalar rebuild, every metered debit against the ledger, every solver call repeated without G15 with real-compression certificates, every row removed by the screen re-solved by the full solver (it must have no joint root), the counter identities, and every 8th trial plants a joint root that the screen and both traversals must keep. The returned pair is built by steps CO and CT on the harness instance (counter 0, flags 11, t_hi = 0, the c1 forcing t = 0) for the trial's context and first passing member. No BLAKE3 library.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, the 128 masked bits: after the first half of round 2 the two states differ only in Y3 and Y11, and the only differing message word of the diagonal step is w5; none enters diagonals 0 and 2. The 16 observations are the program's own counts, untrusted: blocks, live, ranges, words, e_lanes, passes, prechecked (passing lanes whose pre-check keeps an outcome), solver_calls (prechecked lanes with a row that passes the screen), roots, certified, units, solver_units, checks, mismatches, halted, live_steps. Expected per trial (outcome set S = {285020a0}): about 8 blocks, 0.8 live, 13 words, 84 E lanes, 0.28 passes, 0.07 prechecked and 0.01 solver calls, almost always no root; mismatches and halted 0. The counter instance cannot be digest-checked by the organizer; the run is not evidence of attack cost.
